user.title: Dashboard Base
user.description: Create a dashboard: choose a name for the sidebar item and the entities this dashboard may see and control. You can upload your HTML dashboard now or later. Without a file, the dashboard shows a message that explains where to upload it.

data_description.entities: Only these entities are visible to this dashboard. Scenes and scripts you add may do more than this list.
data_description.html: One self-contained .html file (up to 2 MB, no external resources).

error.html_too_large: The file is larger than 2 MB.
error.html_invalid: The file is not a valid UTF-8 file with HTML.

abort.max_dashboards: You can add at most 5 dashboards. Remove a dashboard first to add a new one.

init.title: Dashboard Base
init.description:
Current file: {current}

Change the name or the allowed entities. Choose Upload HTML dashboard to replace the current file, or leave it empty to keep it. Turn on Remove HTML to delete the file.
